onboarding.title: Plan the perfect coop
onboarding.text: Tell us how many hens you keep and how much room you have. We will help you build a coop they will love to roost in.

onboarding.title: Know every breed
onboarding.text: Find out who is who in your flock, from fluffy Silkies to busy Leghorns, and what each one needs to stay happy.

onboarding.title: Share your flock
onboarding.text: Post photos, swap tips and cheer on other keepers. Every hen deserves a little fame.

onboarding.title: Ask the coop helper
onboarding.text: Feed, eggs, a hen acting funny? Ask any time of day and get a friendly answer fast.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: Your flock is safe, we will reconnect soon.
